entity Order
tf 01 pcr InventoryProcessor

tf 02 cmd CartUI [[Data1]]
rf 03 rmo External.InventoryChanged `json` {"a": 2}
tf 4 cmd InventoryProcessor
rf 05 evt Payment.Charge

rf 6 evt Shop.Cart ->> 01 ->> 4

  price: 20.4
  count: 3
}
